title: Postcard and Harbor
author: Wren Yarrow
blurb: Ivo Voss, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
